in_english.name: Nahyd
in_english.long_meaning: Nahyd is an Arabic-originated name that signifies elevated position, high rank, and nobility. Etymologically derived from the Arabic root 'n-h-y-d', it connotes a sense of rising, ascending, or being exalted. Historically used in Islamic tradition, the name Nahyd symbolizes spiritual ascension and moral excellence. It is associated with positive personality traits such as leadership, dignity, and honor.
